---
title: Migrating to 2.0
description: Update manifests and commands from the legacy PBS-only interface.
---

Version 2.0 removes legacy layers that obscured input and output paths.

## Required changes

- Add the `run` subcommand. The pre-2.0 no-subcommand invocation is removed.
- Replace one-column sample lists and TopHat `accepted_hits.bam` discovery with
  an explicit `sample_id,bam_path` CSV manifest.
- Replace the standalone `merge-counts` executable with
  `htseq-count-cluster merge`.
- Update environments to Python 3.10 or newer and HTSeq 2.1 or newer.
- Expect count outputs named `<sample_id>.counts.tsv`; historical `.out` files
  are no longer discovered by the merge command.

## Scheduler behavior

The embedded PBS template and polling helper are removed. PBS commands are
generated directly, and status checks run once. Slurm uses one array job with
optional `--max-concurrent` throttling.

Use `--dry-run` before submitting at each cluster site. It validates inputs and
prints the scheduler command without consuming allocation resources.
